summary: iteration_846: Programmatic PDF-content verification of the Travel Visa Certificate bug-fix task (3 items). 9/9 pytest PASS via http://localhost:8001. critical_code_review_comments: travel_visa_ext.py::_generate_certificate_pdf (lines ~580-670): signature image draws via ImageReader with preserveAspectRatio and mask='auto' — the small horizontal signature line (base_y+34) sits directly under the drawn PNG, which is exactly the visual layout expected. Text 'Adjimon Kouatonou — Program Director' uses an em-dash — renders correctly in Helvetica-Bold and extracts cleanly via PyMuPDF.

The 'VERIFY AUTHENTICITY' fit-to-width loop is robust: it starts with spaced letters at 7pt, decrements to 5.5pt if needed, and falls back to the compact 'VERIFY AUTHENTICITY' string. Verified rect right edge = 755.4pt vs. panel right edge 770pt — comfortable ~14.6pt safety margin.

Certified stamp uses `stamp_drawn` guard — the old RAC/CERTIFIED circle fallback only fires when the PNG is missing. certified-stamp.png (74pt square) and adjimon-signature-handwritten.png (118x36pt) exist in /app/backend/static/branding/ and are correctly embedded.

_format_cert_date correctly normalises stored ISO timestamps to 'Month DD, YYYY'; the regenerate-all path (line 894) passes cert.created_at through _format_cert_date so re-issued PDFs no longer contain raw ISO. Verified end-to-end.
Verify JSON endpoint now returns 404 for unknown IDs (previously 200 with valid:false in iteration_845). Aligned with HTML variant — the advisory action item from iteration_845 landed.
